ORAL JUDGMENT :-
1)
This First Appeal under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (for short LA Act) is filed by the Original Claimant for enhancement in the compensation Kavita.
2/4 11 fa -225-15 towards the 1221 Orange trees, which were on the acquired land.
The Appellant's land admesuring 03 H 20 R and 00H 54 R respectively at village Karajgaon (Gandhighar) Tq.Warud District Amvarati came to be acquired for the ' Loni Dhawalgiri Project'.
The Section 4 Notification was issued on 24.01.2004.
The Special Land Acquisition Officer, declared the Award on 25.04.2006 awarding the compensation of Rs.1,599/- per Orange tree.

sentences.text: The learned Reference Court by the Judgment and Award dated 29.11.2013, enhanced the compensation for the Orange trees @ Rs.2,596/- per Orange tree.

2) The learned Advocate for the Appellant submits that, this Court in First Appeal No.33 of 2015,
arising out of the same acquisition proceedings, enhanced the rate for the Orange trees at Rs.3,200/-per tree.

He submits that, as this Appeal arise out of the same acquisition proceedings,
out of the same Notification, for the same project and the lands are situated in the same village, the same be allowed in terms of Kavita.
3/4 11 fa -225-15  the said Judgment of this Court.
3) It is submitted by the learned Advocated for the acquiring body that, the learned Reference Court has rightly considered the material on record and enhanced the compensation towards the trees.
He, however, does not dispute that, this Court in the above referred Appeal has granted enhanced compensation towards the Orange trees.
4) The learned Advocate for the Appellant submits that, the Appellant waives the enhancement towards the land.

Perusal of the Judgment dated 16.02.2026 by this Court in First Appeal No.33 of 2015 shows that, 80% of the rate calculated by the valuer towards the Orange trees was granted and the same was quantified at Rs.3,200/- per tree.
The papers on record goes to show that, the valuer examined by the Appellant in the present Reference was the same valuer for the Orange trees.
This Appeal and the said Appeal arise out of the same acquisition proceedings, for the same project and out of the same Section 4 Notification.
There is nothing to show that, the Appellant is not entitled for the same rate on the ground of parity towards the Kavita.
Orange trees
. Considering the above referred undisputed aspects of the matter, the following order is passed.
ORDER  i) The Appeal is partly allowed.
ii) The Award passed by the learned Reference  dated 29.11.2013 in LAC No.209 of 2007 stands modified to the extent of the rate for the Orange trees.
iii) The Appellant shall be entitled for the enhance rate of Rs.3,200/- per Orange tree for 1221 Orange trees.
iv) The total amount of enhanced compensation for the Orange trees be accordingly calculated.
